description: Tamper rejection for the v0.5 `message` entry (§9.8/§13.4): the consuming agent reconstructs message_signed_context from the entry it RECEIVED (re-reading the bound from/id/to and recomputing payload_sha256 from the received content fields). The honest control MUST verify first — a verifier that rejects everything cannot vacuously pass the tamper cases. Each tampered variant diverges the reconstructed context, so verification MUST fail with a signature mismatch (not an incidental window/key/jti rejection). Note the complementary shape gate: an unsigned field injected in transit (e.g. a `state` blob) keeps a valid signature because the digest binds only content fields — schema validation, not the signature, rejects it (sv-028, §13.4 step 1).
obligation: Verify the honest entry (positive control), then reject every tampered variant with a signature mismatch. Expected runner wiring (#26): mirror the dp-006 branch — reconstruct the context from each entry via the §9.8 message context builder (recomputed digest, entry's from/id/to, fixture t/jti) and verify against the fixture `v1`.
